answer: Weight needs one registered jade-carving workshop per identity: a certified master carver, inspected premises, each piece assayed and hallmarked, so one workshop backs exactly one identity, duplicate hallmarks rejected. Each fake costs one real workshop: 1,500 units in lease, tools and assay fees plus 120 days to a first hallmarked piece, inspections across that horizon. One hundred fakes cost 150,000 units and 100 workshops. Cheapest cheat: renting a carver's workshop — but the lender loses its own anchor while its hallmark serves another, and a copied hallmark fails its serial check.
